title: 1945 The bridge's pedestrian walkway was built
description: In 1944, the Department of Transportation built a new concrete approach with reinforced supports on the east end of the bridge. They also installed lights at that time, improving safety and visibility. In March 1945, construction began on a covered pedestrian sidewalk along the south side, effectively creating a separate attached walkway that paralleled the main bridge. Pictured on the right are Henry and Lois Downey, Clayton Cox's parents. (Courtesy of Jason Parsons and Ralph Seeley)
